nodes.description: Public string state variable 'name' holding the token name.
Public string state variable 'symbol' holding the token symbol.
Public uint8 state variable 'decimals' holding token decimals.
Public uint256 state variable '_totalSupply' holding the total token supply.
Mapping 'balances' storing token balances per address.
Nested mapping 'allowed' storing allowances owner => spender => amount.
Constructor of toebeans: sets name, symbol, decimals, _totalSupply and mints supply to msg.sender.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address) returns the balance of tokenOwner.
allowance(address,address) returns the remaining allowance for a spender.
approve(address,uint) writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
transfer(address,uint) moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom(address,address,uint) moves tokens using allowance, with safeSub/safeAdd only.
SafeMath safeAdd(uint,uint) with overflow require check.
SafeMath safeSub(uint,uint) with underflow require check.
SafeMath safeMul(uint,uint) with overflow require check.
SafeMath safeDiv(uint,uint) with division-by-zero require check.
msg.sender used as the caller identity for minting, approving, transferring and allowance checks.
safeSub(balances[msg.sender], tokens) state-mutating subtraction in transfer.
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) state-mutating addition in transfer.
safeSub(balances[from], tokens) state-mutating subtraction in transferFrom.
safeSub(allowed[from][msg.sender], tokens) allowance subtraction in transferFrom.
safeAdd(balances[to], tokens) state-mutating addition in transferFrom.
Raw unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply().

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the token name to state variable 'name'.
Constructor assigns the token symbol to state variable 'symbol'.
Constructor assigns decimals to state variable 'decimals'.
Constructor assigns the initial supply to state variable '_totalSupply'.
Constructor mints the total supply into balances[msg.sender].
msg.sender is used by the constructor as the mint recipient.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping during minting in the constructor.
approve() keys the allowance mapping with the caller msg.sender.
msg.sender is the owner key written into the allowed mapping in approve().
transfer() debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller identity.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender when deducting allowance.
transfer() calls safeSub to deduct the sender balance.
transfer() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom() calls safeSub for the balance and allowance deductions.
transferFrom() calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.

transfer() performs safeAdd on balances[to].
transferFrom() performs safeSub on balances[from].

transferFrom() performs safeAdd on balances[to].

safeSub result is written back into the balances mapping in transfer().
